latest_release.body: # Minor changes, and were opening store for module. finally. # This update also mainly focuses on reducing battery drain, and ram usage. # THIS UPDATE REMOVED PRONUNCIATION, I FORGOT TO ADD IT BACK ## No paid module on module store changes 1. You can save presets for audioFx now 2. New lyrics sorting options, and new provider. 3. Bugfix in 3rd party module playback, and adding more module support, to see more, check the documentation web 4, Audio Lab presets (Audio FX) 5. More modules things, player layouts can build their own up-next cards and queue views, with a queue list block, a volume bar, tappable panels, cover songs Yt vid, its animated cover or the module's own loop 6. Unison is now a lyrics provider 7. Override lyrics sorting in Settings > App behaviour > Lyrics to drag the providers into your own order. 8. series of optimisation Fixes - Songs shared in from a file manager play from where they are instead of being copied into the app - making the canvas or animated cover GIF no longer runs the app out of memory for discord - the Playback speed and Exponential volume cards respond to taps and slides again. wow - for dacs, skipping between tracks with different sample rates or formats no longer stalls at the end of a song, collides with the mixer or plays a distorted burst.. an old output can no longer clear the new dac setting or stop the next song. - retrying or falling back from a broken module stream clears its cached audio. adaptive dash or any hls links with query strings, and background fetch errors, are handled properly rn. idk this can break again, i hope not - dolby atmox fix, now multichannel tracks go through the headphone renderer even with hi-res float on. - i hope, less battery drain in the background and with the screen on - signing and key storage for module store moved into native code, and unsigned or fork sign-in and session leaks are blocked. sorry. - an album now stops at its last song with autoplay off. - And other fixes

detail.readme:
What is Mochy Music? its a sleek modern cool music player for android, open source, packed with features and doesn’t collect ur data >_< !! oh and, still in beta! so please expect some bug :)


> [!WARNING] > This app still on beta!, expect some bugs! reporting it will be useful too!!! --- ## Hhhh-how to install? :3 1. On your phone, open the [latest release](https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music/releases/latest). 2. Download the `.apk` that matches your phone. If you are not sure, pick **arm64**, that is almost every phone from the last 8 years. The **universal** one works everywhere but is bigger. 3. Open the downloaded file. Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager, say yes (you can turn it off again after). 4. Open Mochy. You are done, no account needed to start listening. Updating works the same way: install the new apk over the old one and your library stays. > [!TIP] > Only download Mochy from the releases page of this repo. A random mediafire or telegram link could be a modified app, and then your logins would not be safe, pls avoid those > [!BTW] > We support android 7 unofficially. --- ## Some Prview --- # FAQ Q - Is it safe to log in? (read this before signing in) A - Tbh, you never have to log in to use this thing btw. Search, play, lyrics and downloads work without an account. Signing in is only for syncing your YouTube Music library, importing playlists from Spotify / Apple Music / Tidal, and Discord status **How the sign-in works** - Mochy opens the real login page of the service (for example accounts.google.com or open.spotify.com) inside the app. You type your password into **their** page, not into a Mochy form. - After you log in, the app keeps the session token or cookie that the service gives out, so you stay signed in. Your password is not what gets saved. - That session stays on your phone, in the app's private storage. Mochy has no account system of its own and does not run a server that collects logins. - The tokens are meant to be used only to talk to the service you signed in to (for example Spotify's own site to read your playlists). - The app is open source under GPL-3.0 so you do not have to take my word for it, you can always read exactly what it does with them :) Q - Pls add liquid glass A - No, and not now. maybe in form of modules created by someone in the future Q - Monochrome/flac stream doesnt work A - The server down, its on their side not us. use other anvailable sources, join our discord Q - Animation is too slow, can you speed it up? A - You can speed it up on customize page. Q - Official Desktop app? A - Later Q - App too laggy, how to fix? A - Disabling blur will helps Q - Can i contribute? A - Ofc Q - Can you add less spacing for the player A - You can customize it yourself Q - I hate this app, i dont want to use it A - Nobody is forcing you to use this --- ## How to build it yourself You only need this if you want to change the code. If you just want to use the app, use the install steps above. ### What you need - A Mac, Linux or Windows computer with screen - [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio) (latest stable). It brings JDK 21 and the Android SDK with it - Android SDK 36 and NDK `27.0.12077973`. Android Studio offers to download both the first time you open the project - About 10 gb free disk space, the first build downloads a lottt - A phone with USB debugging on, or an emulator. ### Steps ```bash git clone https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music.git cd mochy-music ``` 1. Open the folder in Android Studio once and let it finish syncing. This also creates `local.properties` with your SDK path. 2. Build and install on your connected phone: ```bash ./build.sh --debug -i ``` First build takes a while, the next ones are much faster. 3. Or build the apk only and install it by hand. The apk lands in `apk-generated/`: ```bash ./build.sh --debug adb install -r apk-generated/*-debug.apk ``` Handy options (see `./build.sh --help` for all of them): | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `./build.sh --debug -i` | debug build, installs and opens it on your phone | | `./build.sh --release -cc` | release build for arm64 and universal | | `./build.sh -fd --release` | F-Droid flavor, without the self-update permission | | `./build.sh -k` | stops stuck Gradle builds | Use **debug** while you are playing around, it builds much much faster. A debug build installs next to the real app (`com.example.mochy.debug`), so it will not touch your normal install, but it is also a bit slower to run. ### Optional keys Mochy builds fine without these, only the matching feature is switched off. Put them in `local.properties` (it is never committed): ```properties LASTFM_API_KEY=... LASTFM_SECRET=... DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=... ``` Never commit your keys. Libre.fm works without any key. ### If the build fails - `Unresolved reference` or Hilt errors that make no sense: delete the `build/` folders and `.gradle/` and build again. - Stuck or weird Gradle: `./build.sh -k`, then try again. - Wrong Java: make sure Gradle uses JDK 21 (Android Studio → Settings → Build Tools → Gradle → Gradle JDK). - Still stuck? Open an [issue](https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music/issues) with the error text. Want to send a fix? Read [CONTRIBUTING](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) first. --- ## How to build module? im working on it wait --- ## Wants to help? bug report? report it on issues! Or read contribute.md there --- ## Disclaimer Mochy is an independent, unofficial project made for personal and educational use. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. - Mochy is a fully open source project that is created purely for educationa and personal use. thats why, we dont sell this software, or monetize it. we do not have any intent to add commercial values in the future. thanks! - And were deeply respect the hardwork of artist musicians ajd contwnt creators. without them there is also no mochy: i strongly suggest that you, as user, subscribe to Apple music or youtube premium, to support the creators you listen. I do not intend to hurt creator with this app. - It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by** YouTube, YouTube Music, Google, Spotify, Apple, Last.fm, Shazam, Discord or any other service it can connect to. All names, logos and brands belong to their respective owners. - Mochy does not host, store or distribute any music. Everything is fetched from third-party services when you ask for it, and those services can change or stop working at any time. - You are responsible for how you use the app, including the terms of service of the accounts and services you connect and the copyright laws where you live. - Importing from other services (Spotify, etc.) uses your own account. Don't share your login data or tokens with anyone. - Importing music MAY need your own account with its password. WE'RE NEVER see your password. --- ## Forking Mochy Forks are welcome, that's what open source is for! Just two asks: - **Keep the credit.** If you rename it, please keep credits of this app, the other project that helped mochy possible. - **Keep it free.** Mochy is not monetized and never will be. Please don't put features behind a paywall. A donation page is fine. --- ## These incredible project helped mochy a lot! check them out too :3 - **ViviMusic** by [vivizzz007Z](https://github.com/vivizzz007Z) )[Their repo](https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music)) -- For the base app. This app is a fork from this project. - **Metrolist** by [Mostafa Alagamy](https://github.com/mostafaalagamy) ([Repository](https://github.com/mostafaalagamy/Metrolist)) -- For the base framework. - **SimpMusic** by [maxrave-dev](https://github.com/maxrave-dev) ([Repository](https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic)) -- For the lyrics API provider. - **Archivetune** by [Rukamori](https://github.com/rukamori) ([Repository](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune)) -- For design and architectural inspiration. - **RiMusic / InnerTube** by [fast4x](https://github.com/fast4x) ([Repository](https://github.com/fast4x/RiMusic)) -- For YouTube Music InnerTube API service wrapper. - **LRCLib** by [tranxuanthang](https://github.com/tranxuanthang) ([Repository](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrclib) / [Website](https://lrclib.net/)) -- For synchronized LRC lyrics provider integration. - **Monochrome Music** by [monochrome-music](https://github.com/monochrome-music) ([Repository](https://github.com/monochrome-music/monochrome) / ([Website](https://monochrome.st)) -- Flac streams, visit their web, very cool one. - **Auto Eq** ([Web](https://autoeq.app)) -- The equalizer database - **lrc.red** ([Web](https://lrc.red)) -- Word-timed lyrics for millions of songs, free for everyone - **InnertubeX** by [nyxireal](https://github.com/nyxiereal) [Their repo](https://github.com/metrolistGroup/innertubex) For The Youtube API Access --- ## Open source APIs mochy talks to!! These are the open source apis and server we get gets its lyrics, streams and data from. They r free for everyone because of these good people, so go give them a star! - **LyricsPlus** by [Ibra Al Tabian](https://github.com/ibratabian17) ([repos](https://github.com/ibratabian17/LyricsPlus)) s - **Better Lyrics API** by [Boidushya](https://github.com/boidushya) ([repos](https://github.com/better-lyrics/api)) - **LRCLIB** by [tranxuanthang](https://github.com/tranxuanthang) ([repos](https://github.com/tranxuanthang/lrclib) / [Website](https://lrclib.net/)) - **SimpMusic Lyrics** by [maxrave-dev](https://github.com/maxrave-dev) ([repos](https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic)) --- ## Star History
